name: Gang Style Feature
summary: Gang Style Feature Gunslinger Once per short rest, make one pistol attack as a bonus action after taking the Attack action. Knife Rat Your light melee attacks deal +1 damage. Chem-User You gain advantage on saving throws against poison and combat drugs. Sump Ghost You may hide when lightly obscured by smoke, steam, crowds, or machinery.
